meta.title: Australia - Sydney & West Coast 2027
meta.dates: Dec 15, 2027 – early Jan 2028 (FLL → Los Angeles → Sydney · Perth · Margaret River)

route.name: Sydney
route.sub: 4 nights (room held from Dec 16) · Sydney Harbour Marriott

blocks.title: Arrive FLL Terminal 3 — JetBlue bag drop
blocks.detail:
• 2 hrs ahead of a domestic flight — holiday-week crowds, family of 4, 3 checked bags.
• Bags are tagged to LAX only: this is a separate ticket from the American flight to Sydney.
• JetBlue bag drop closes 40 min before departure.
• Hats, sun shirts and sunscreen in the carry-ons — landing day is a full day out in Brisbane.
blocks.notes:
• Award fares don't include a checked bag: 3 bags × $49 (peak) = $147 — estimated; $39 per bag if Dec 15 is off-peak.
• Prepay in the app; bags added within 24 hrs of departure cost $10 more each.
blocks.flag: Departs Fort Lauderdale, not Miami — plan the drive up and parking.

blocks.title: TSA, then lunch to go — FLL Terminal 3
blocks.detail:
• Buy lunch after security to eat on the plane — the flight spans lunchtime and JetBlue only sells snack boxes.
• Refill water bottles at the gate.
blocks.notes: • ~$50 for 2 adult + 2 kids' grab-and-go meals — estimated.

blocks.title: At the gate — boarding
blocks.detail:
• Bathroom stop before boarding.
• Boarding starts ~30–40 min before departure.

blocks.title: JetBlue B6201 - FLL → LAX - Nonstop - 5h53m
blocks.detail:
• Departs 12:00 PM Eastern, lands 2:53 PM Pacific (3 hrs behind Florida).
• Economy, 4 passengers.
• Lunch on board. Kids: a nap of 45 min max — the long sleep happens on the Sydney flight.
• All LAX times below are Pacific.
blocks.notes:
• Not booked.
• Seen on seats.aero (Oct 2026 search): 16,300 TrueBlue pts + $5.60 per person → 65,200 pts + $22.40 for four. Class U, 9 seats.
• Same flight via United MileagePlus: 35,000 pts + $5.60 per person.
• Separate ticket from the LAX → Sydney leg.
blocks.flag:
If this flight cancels or runs very late, rebook the same day: American MIA → LAX nonstops at ~1:45 PM and ~3:40 PM Eastern still make the 10:40 PM Sydney flight.
American isn't responsible for a missed connection on a separate ticket — get travel insurance that covers missed connections.

blocks.title: Land LAX — deplane, Terminal 1
blocks.detail:
• JetBlue uses Terminal 1 at LAX — confirm the week before.
• Domestic arrival: no immigration or customs.
• Bathroom stop on the way to baggage claim.

blocks.title: Baggage claim — Terminal 1
blocks.detail:
• Collect all 3 checked bags.
• Grab a luggage cart at claim.

blocks.title: Terminal 1 → Terminal 4 (American)
blocks.detail:
• Stay landside — exit claim and walk west along the Upper/Departures Level sidewalk past Terminals 2 and 3 to Terminal 4 (~0.4 mi, ~20 min with a cart and kids).
• Alternative: the free LAX inter-terminal shuttle from the Lower/Arrivals Level island outside Terminal 1.
• American's Sydney flight checks in at Terminal 4.

blocks.title: Wait landside at Terminal 4 — bag drop opens ~4 hrs before departure
blocks.detail:
• American normally accepts checked bags from ~4 hrs before departure (≈6:40 PM) — ask at the counter around 5 PM; agents sometimes take them earlier.
• Snacks and bathrooms landside; kids can stretch their legs.
• Online check-in opens 24 hrs before departure — have passports and the Australian ETA confirmations ready.
blocks.flag: Confirm the exact bag-drop opening time for AA73 the week before — the separate-ticket gap at LAX is ~4 hrs.

blocks.title: American check-in and bag drop — Terminal 4
blocks.detail:
• Bags tagged through to Sydney.
• Check-in closes 60 min before departure (9:40 PM).
• Economy allowance on this ticket: confirm per the award booking (typically 1–2 bags × 23 kg / 50 lb each).

blocks.title: TSA security — Terminal 4
blocks.detail: • Holiday-week evening rush — 30 min allowed.

blocks.title: Dinner airside — Terminal 4
blocks.detail:
• Full dinner here so everyone can skip the onboard dinner and sleep right after takeoff.
• Light on sugar and caffeine.
blocks.notes: • ~USD 70 for 2 adult + 2 kids' meals at airport prices, incl. tax and tip — estimated.

blocks.title: Wind down — pajamas, teeth, quiet time
blocks.detail:
• Kids change into pajamas and brush teeth.
• Dim screens, quiet activities — no new movies started.

blocks.title: Walk to the gate and board
blocks.detail:
• Boarding starts ~50 min before departure; the gate closes 15–20 min before.
• Last bathroom stop at the gate.

blocks.title: American AA73 - LAX → SYD - Nonstop - ~15h20m
blocks.detail:
• Economy, 4 passengers, Boeing 777-300ER.
• Departs 10:40 PM Pacific = 5:40 PM Thursday in Sydney.
• Crosses the International Date Line — Thursday Dec 16 disappears in flight.
• Lands 9:00 AM Friday Dec 17, Sydney time (AEDT, UTC+11; 16 hrs ahead of Florida).
blocks.notes:
• Not booked — planning assumption: 40,000 Atmos + ~USD 47.50 per person → 160,000 pts + USD 190 for four (same points as the earlier LAX → BNE assumption).
• Seen on seats.aero (Dec 2026 stand-in): Atmos 75,000–125,000 pts + USD 47.50 per person; American AAdvantage 50,000–64,500 on some dates; Delta DL41 (10:15 PM → 8:30 AM) 106,200+ SkyMiles.
• Award space for Dec 15, 2027 opens ~Jan 2027.

SLEEP PLAN (Sydney time in brackets):
• Skip the dinner service; lights out by ~11:15 PM LA (6:15 PM Sydney).
• Eye masks, earplugs, kids' headphones.
• Let the kids sleep until breakfast — ask the crew to wake them ~90 min before landing (~7:30 AM Sydney).
• Breakfast on board; window shades up so everyone is awake for landing.
blocks.flag: Atmos pricing on this route ran well above 40,000 pts in the Dec 2026 data — re-check when Dec 2027 opens; American AAdvantage or Delta may be cheaper.

days.title: Land Sydney → harbour walk: The Rocks, Opera House, Botanic Garden

blocks.title: Arrive SYD Terminal 1 (International) — immigration, bags, biosecurity
blocks.detail:
• SmartGate for adult US e-passports; kids use the staffed lane with a parent.
• Declare any food — don't carry fruit or snacks off the plane.
• 75 min gate-to-curb for a family with 3 checked bags, incl. a bathroom stop.

blocks.title: Walk to the taxi rank — T1 Arrivals level
blocks.detail:
• From: the arrivals hall → follow the "Taxi" signs out to the rank on the Arrivals level.
• Ask the rank marshal for a Maxi Taxi (4 people + 3 checked bags + carry-ons).

blocks.title: Maxi Taxi SYD T1 → Sydney Harbour Marriott, Circular Quay
blocks.detail:
• To: Sydney Harbour Marriott main entrance, 30 Pitt St, Circular Quay.
• ~13 km; 25–35 min on a Friday late morning.
• Taxi beats the train after a 15-hr flight: door to door with 3 checked bags, about the same cost for four (the airport train station fee is charged per adult).
• Backup: Uber XL from the T1 rideshare pick-up area.
blocks.notes:
• Sydney Airport fixed-fare taxi trial: AUD 60 standard / AUD 80 maxi to the CBD (verified, NSW Point to Point Commissioner) = USD ~52.
• The trial started Nov 3, 2025 for 18 months — if it has ended by Dec 2027, expect a metered fare of roughly AUD 60–80 — estimated.
blocks.flag: The fixed-fare trial is due to end ~May 2027 — re-check the fare closer to the trip.

blocks.title: Check in — Sydney Harbour Marriott, Circular Quay (room held from Dec 16)
blocks.detail:
• 30 Pitt St — 2 min from the Circular Quay ferry wharves, 5 min from The Rocks.
• Room: 2 double beds (sleeps 4).
• Booked from the night of Thu Dec 16, so the room is ready the moment you arrive.
• Indoor pool.
blocks.nights: 5 nights booked (Thu Dec 16 – Tue Dec 21; Dec 16 night holds the room for an early check-in)
blocks.notes:
• Planning assumption: 264,000 Bonvoy points for 5 nights — 66,000 × 4 with the 5th night free on a points stay.
• Marriott points rates include the room tax; no resort or destination fee.
• Not booked — Dec 2027 points dates open ~Jan 2027.
blocks.flag: Confirm the 2-double-bed room type books on points for 2 adults + 2 children.

blocks.title: Showers, unpack, unwind in the room
blocks.detail:
• 90 min: showers, fresh clothes, feet up.
• No naps — keep the kids awake so they sleep tonight.
• Curtains open for daylight to help reset body clocks.

blocks.title: Walk to The Glenmore, The Rocks
blocks.detail:
• From: Marriott, Pitt St exit → left on Alfred St → right up George St into The Rocks → left up the Argyle Stairs to Cumberland St.
• To: The Glenmore, 96 Cumberland St — ~700 m, uphill, 15 min.

blocks.title: Lunch — The Glenmore (rooftop views of the Opera House and harbour)
blocks.detail:
• Classic 1920s Rocks pub with one of Sydney's best rooftop views over Circular Quay and the Opera House.
• Kids' meals: tomato pasta, popcorn chicken & chips, battered fish & chips (with an adult meal).
• Open from 11 AM.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU:
• The Rocks burger AUD 25 + chicken schnitzel AUD 27
• 2 kids' meals AUD 15.50 each
• = AUD 83 ≈ USD 54.
• Friday: no public-holiday surcharge.
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.
blocks.flag: Confirm kids can sit on the rooftop (call +61 2 9247 4794) — otherwise eat in the downstairs dining room.

blocks.title: Observatory Hill Park — Harbour Bridge lookout
blocks.detail:
• From: The Glenmore → up Cumberland St and Watson Rd (~300 m, 5 min).
• Free. Big lawn and rotunda on the highest point of The Rocks, looking straight at the Harbour Bridge.
• Room for the kids to run around after the flight.

blocks.title: Walk down under the Bridge — Dawes Point Park → Campbells Cove
blocks.detail:
• From: Observatory Hill → down the Agar Steps / Lower Fort St to Dawes Point Park, right under the southern end of the Bridge.
• Then along the waterfront past Campbells Cove and the cruise terminal.
• To: Circular Quay West — ~1.3 km, 60 min at an easy pace with photo stops.

blocks.title: Walk Circular Quay → Opera House forecourt
blocks.detail:
• From: Circular Quay West → past the ferry wharves and along East Circular Quay.
• To: Sydney Opera House forecourt — ~700 m, 15 min.
• Free toilets at the Museum of Contemporary Art (Circular Quay West) on the way.

blocks.title: Opera House → Royal Botanic Garden → Mrs Macquarie's Chair
blocks.detail:
• From: Opera House forecourt → through the Queen Elizabeth II Gate into the Royal Botanic Garden; follow the Farm Cove foreshore path.
• To: Mrs Macquarie's Chair — the classic photo of the Opera House with the Bridge behind (~1.5 km from the Opera House).
• Free. Shade and lawns along the way; turn back early if the kids are fading.
• Sit on the lawns facing Farm Cove for a break before heading back.

blocks.title: Walk back to East Circular Quay
blocks.detail:
• From: Mrs Macquarie's Chair → back along Farm Cove to the Opera House.
• To: Whalebridge, 8–10 East Circular Quay — ~1.6 km, 25 min with tired kids; 5 min buffer.

blocks.title: Dinner — Whalebridge (waterfront, East Circular Quay)
blocks.detail:
• French bistro on the water, looking at the Opera House and Harbour Bridge.
• Kids' menu: burger, fish & chips, crumbed chicken or ham & cheese baguette.
• Book the bistro for 6:00 PM (walk-ins only in the bar); ask for an outdoor waterfront table.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU (Oct 2026):
• Burger Maison AUD 34 + Poisson et Frites AUD 38
• 2 kids' mains AUD 15 each (kids menu: https://sundayco.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/14-WLB-Kids-Menu-2026_New-WR1.pdf)
• = AUD 102 ≈ USD 66.
• Friday: no public-holiday surcharge.
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.

blocks.title: Opera House steps — last look at the harbour
blocks.detail:
• From: Whalebridge → north along East Circular Quay to the Opera House steps (~250 m, 4 min).
• Quick photo stop before bed; sunset is ~8 PM.

blocks.title: Walk back to the Marriott — in the room by 7:30
blocks.detail:
• From: Opera House → south along East Circular Quay, past the ferry wharves, left up Pitt St.
• To: Marriott, 30 Pitt St — ~800 m, 15 min.
• Pajamas and lights out soon after — first night in Australia.

blocks.title: Draft — to plan
blocks.detail:
• Ferry Circular Quay → Manly (30 min).
• Manly beach and the Shelly Beach snorkel (water ~71°F).

blocks.title: Draft — to plan
blocks.detail: • Bondi to Bronte coastal walk; Bronte ocean pool.

blocks.title: Draft — to plan
blocks.detail:
• BridgeClimb (Dad + son, age 8+).
• Jenny and Chloe: Pylon Lookout and Storytime Ballet at the Opera House.
• Afternoon: Darling Harbour.

blocks.title: Draft — to plan
blocks.detail:
• Check out of the Marriott.
• Fly SYD → PER (~5 hrs).
• Drive to Smiths Beach Resort, Yallingup (~3 hrs) — or one night in Perth first.
